people.imagined: A night crossing in the dark forest. He has stopped at a bend to relight the lead lamp after the Tower's patrol fined him for it, and the new flame lights the burn on his chin. He is not hurrying.
people.subject: The moment: in a black rain forest at night he holds a horn lantern up beside his face and tilts it toward the viewer, relit after a bend. Face: most important, the lamp-burn: a shiny, wrinkled, red-pink burn patch the size of a palm covers his chin and jaw, lit by the new flame, clearly visible. A square, weather-brown face with a broad forehead; steady dark brown eyes; thick straight brows; a wide nose; a grim, calm mouth; a short black stubble over the scar; deep lines beside the mouth, about forty-one. Hair: black with grey at the temples, bound in a short knot with a plain jade-green cord, rain-wet. Body: solid, middle-sized, planted wide. Clothing: layered robes of forest-brown silk with two crossed collars, a grey-green gauze over-robe with narrow vine embroidery at the cuffs, a woven silk belt; over the shoulders a short rain cape of straw fine as silk, dull gold, its tips beaded with water; a rolled blanket across his back. Hands and objects: a horn lantern, its small yellow spirit-flame steady, held at shoulder height in his right hand; in the left a pale-gripped bamboo staff planted on the ground. Power: faint green motes of wood qi drift up from the wet ferns around him, and a thread of pale metal-grey shimmers along the staff. Background: black trunks of giant bamboo veiled in blue mist, rain in thin silver streaks. Light: the yellow lantern glow on the lower right of his face and the scar, cool blue moonlight on the left, a soft rim of silver on the rain. Expression: a steady, unhurried gaze, the jaw set, the mouth grim but still, a man who will not be hurried by any patrol.

people.imagined: The staff grove at dusk. A child has brought a staff cut from a bamboo in flower, and he turns it over once, shakes his head, and hands it back without a word. His left thumb is pared flat from forty years of bamboo knife.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk in a bamboo grove he holds out one cut staff, sighting along its length with one eye closed, his left hand raised so the thumb shows. Face: most important, the left thumb: pared flat and wide, the nail gone as if shaved, pink and shiny, held close beside his face. A long, dry, deeply lined face of about fifty-six the colour of old bamboo; narrow slate-grey eyes, one squeezed shut; a long thin nose; lips pressed thin; a grey goatee cut square; high bony brows. Hair: iron grey, short at the sides, in a topknot held by a slim green-jade pin. Body: tall, narrow, rigid, with a slight stoop at the neck. Clothing: robes of olive silk with two crossed collars and narrow sleeves, over them a deep olive gauze over-robe of an elder, embroidered along the hem and cuffs with fine jungle vines in grey-green thread; a woven silk belt with a bamboo knife in a sheath and a small jade toggle. Hands and objects: a long straight bamboo staff, pale gold, held crosswise before him, the flat-thumbed hand along its length. Power: a calm green aura clings to him like mist among the culms, motes of wood qi rising slowly from the staff. Background: tall green culms dissolving into haze, a rack of cut staffs behind. Light: soft green-gold spirit-light filtering from the upper left through leaves, a gentle glow on the bamboo. Expression: unyielding, judging, reserved.

people.imagined: The second lamp, behind her father. She has smeared soot on her own chin to match his burn and now tilts her face up proudly, impatient to carry the first lamp. Her chin is smudged, the rest clean.
people.subject: The moment: on a dark forest path she walks a step behind and looks forward over her lamp with a proudly lifted chin. Face: most important, the soot smudge: a thick grey-black smear across the chin and jawline, drawn on by hand, obviously fake, lit by the lamp. A narrow, bright, tanned face of about twenty-one; high cheekbones; sharp alert black eyes; thick lifted brows; a small upturned nose; a firm mouth with the start of a grin. Hair: long black hair in a high ponytail tied with a red silk cord, a few damp strands at the cheeks. Body: tall, slim, athletic, standing at an impatient angle. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple: a short tunic of dark-green silk with crossed collar, sleeves tied back at the elbow, a grey-green sash, tan leggings; over her shoulders a small cape of bright new gold straw, fine as silk. Hands and objects: a small horn lantern held out before her in both hands with a pale yellow flame; a bamboo staff slung across her back, its top over one shoulder. Background: wet bamboo veiled in blue-green mist, the broad dark back of an older man ahead, rain. Light: lantern glow golden on her face from below right, cool moonlit blue-green on the left. Expression: chin lifted, bright eager eyes fixed ahead, lips pressed together, restless to be first.

people.imagined: A windy pass above the mine. He has just lost his third hat of the season and is holding what is left of his hair down with one hand; a deep boom from below makes him flinch and glance down at the ground.
people.subject: The moment: on a bare wind-swept pass he flinches with shoulders up at a deep boom from below, one hand clutching the top of his head. Face: most important, the flinch: shoulders hunched to the ears, eyes squeezed half shut, mouth open in a small gasp. A young, pale, thin face of about nineteen with a long chin; large pale-blue eyes wide and wet; thin light brows raised; a long nose red from the wind; chapped, flaking lips. Hair: dull brown and thin, blown sideways, a bare patch where a hat should be. Body: narrow, bony, slightly stooped. Clothing: simple graceful silk of an outer disciple: a grey-brown silk tunic with two crossed collars, neatly mended at the elbow with a square of darker silk, a green silk sash, wide sleeves whipping in the gale; a small leather tally satchel across the chest, mine-dust on the knees. Hands and objects: one hand in his hair, the other pressed flat to the satchel, a bundle of tally sticks poking out. Power: a few motes of grey-gold metal qi shiver up from the ground with each boom. Background: a bare ridge under split silver cloud, the dark mouth of a mine tunnel behind, loose stones skittering down the slope. Light: pale cold spirit-light from the upper left, mist at the edges of the frame. Expression: startled, honest, anxious, the wide wet eyes darting down toward the sound.

people.imagined: The ferry landing at noon. He grins at a foot-traveller to show off the gold tooth, which is brass, and names the price of the isle toll, with the pole resting on his shoulder.
people.subject: The moment: on a ferry deck at noon he grins wide at the viewer, pole over his shoulder, one finger tapping a front tooth. Face: most important, the tooth: his upper front tooth is a shining yellow-brass cap, big and obviously metal, bared in the grin. A round, cocky, sunburnt boy's face of about seventeen with a snub nose; bright sly black eyes; thick eyebrows; chubby cheeks; a small scar through the left eyebrow. Hair: spiky black, a short tail tied with blue silk thread. Body: stocky, chest out, chin high. Clothing: the plainest graceful silk of an outer disciple: a river-blue silk vest over a short tan tunic with cut-off wide sleeves, a sash of woven blue silk, a straw hat pushed back by its strap; a string of copper coins on a cord at the neck. Hands and objects: a long bamboo ferry pole on his right shoulder; his left forefinger pointing at the tooth. Power: a little blue-green water qi lifts in glittering spray around the pole. Background: a wide river wreathed in pearl mist, a flat ferry, a small grassy isle beyond. Light: bright luminous noon light from the upper left, soft sparkle and bloom off the water. Expression: cocky, greedy, cheerful.

people.imagined: The coast inn, a sea mist at the window. She has stopped speaking to listen, and her hand has found the pale rubbed patch of her pouch; in it, a letter that was not burned.
people.subject: The moment: in a coast inn by a misty window she stops mid-sentence and tilts her head to listen, her hand resting on a worn pouch at her chest. Face: most important, the pouch: a small leather pouch at the chest, rubbed almost white at one patch where her fingers always touch it, with a folded letter tucked in her cuff, no writing. A calm oval face of about twenty-six with cool grey eyes looking aside; thin straight brows; a high nose; a small mouth; a freckle on the lower lip. Hair: brown with a bronze glint, parted centrally and braided in two plaits pinned around the head like a crown, with a small jade pin. Body: slim, balanced. Clothing: layered silk of an outer disciple, simple and graceful: an ash-grey inner robe with two crossed collars, a deep-blue silk sash, an outer travelling robe of pale straw-coloured gauze with wide sleeves and vine edging in grey-green thread; a bone toggle at the throat. Power: a faint blue breath of water qi curls in the mist about her shoulders. Background: a window of grey sea mist with boat masts as faint dark lines, a table with a bowl, softly blurred. Light: pearly moon-pale light from the window at the upper left, a soft glow along her cheek and plaits. Expression: attentive, watchful, guarded.

people.imagined: A road at dawn, the day he walked home. He has pulled his collar open to show the scratched-out scar on his shoulder, defying anyone to ask. He does not look back at the ford.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a road at dawn he has pulled his collar wide off his left shoulder and glares at the viewer. Face: most important, the shoulder: on the bare left shoulder an angry, raised, scratched-out mark that was once a small bell, a burned pink and white welt crossed with scratches, clear and large. A hard, angular, tanned face of about twenty-five with a heavy jaw; deep-set dark eyes with a cold stare; thick straight brows; a crooked nose; tight lips; a faint flush on the cheekbones, a muscle in the jaw, a vein at the temple. Hair: black, cropped close. Body: broad, muscular, stiff with anger. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of an outer disciple, freshly washed and deep in dye: a dark-brown silk tunic with crossed collars pulled off one shoulder, a grey-green sash with a bronze buckle, a short gold straw cape on the other shoulder, a studded bracer on the right wrist. Hands and objects: a bamboo staff in his right hand, its end on the ground; his left hand pulling the collar. Power: a grey-gold glint of metal qi along the staff and a hot red-orange glimmer low in the air around him. Background: a road in drifting mist, a pale sky, a river ford far behind. Light: cool pearly dawn light from the upper left, a thin silver rim on his shoulder. Expression: defiant, angry, guarded, daring anyone to ask.

people.imagined: The pass in the evening, after a day's walk. He has not once been out of breath. He leans lightly on the pale-gripped bamboo staff and looks at the hills toward the Tower, the one place he must not run to.
people.subject: The moment: at the end of a day's walk on a mountain road he stands easy with both hands on top of a bamboo staff, looking at the viewer without a trace of tiredness. Face: most important, the cape and the staff: a thick cape of straw fine as silk lies over his shoulders, its straw turning silver-grey at the edges, and a bamboo staff polished pale at the grip stands upright before him. A broad, weathered, brown face of about fifty-eight with a wide flat nose; heavy brows; warm steady brown eyes; grey stubble; deep smile-lines; a calm honest mouth. Hair: grey-black, in a topknot under a slim silver-green crown. Body: broad, strongly built, planted, not a drop of sweat. Clothing: the richest robes of the Gate as its head: layered forest-brown and olive silk with three crossed collars, a deep olive gauze over-robe embroidered with jungle vines in silver-green thread along hems and wide sleeves, a woven silk belt, a jade token on a green cord at the chest, unmarked. Hands and objects: both large callused hands on the staff, the jade token. Power: a strong visible aura of green wood qi flows about him like canopy light, with a crackle of violet lightning motes at his fingertips and pale metal glints in the air. Background: a pass between forested hills in rising evening mist. Light: low gold sunset from the upper left, the straw glowing, a soft rim light. Expression: a warm, level gaze, smile-lines creased, the mouth easy and open-hearted.

people.imagined: A lamp-lit hall at night. She carries the road book under one arm and the horn lamp in the other hand, bent under a cape so old that its straw has turned to silver, and she is counting beads without looking.
people.subject: The moment: in a dark hall she shuffles forward bent under her cape, lamp raised, a heavy book under one arm, counting beads without looking. Face: most important, the silver cape: a large rain cape of straw fine as silk, gone entirely silver-white, long and thick and hanging to her knees, filling a third of the frame. A tiny, wrinkled, kind face of about eighty like a dried apple; tiny bright black eyes; white eyebrows; a flat nose; a toothless patient smile; skin the colour of tea. Hair: pure white, in a bun held by a bamboo-and-jade pin. Body: small, bent forward at the shoulder, a humped back under the cape. Clothing: an elder's richest robes: layers of deep olive and brown silk, a deep olive gauze over-robe embroidered with jungle vines in silver thread, wide sleeves; a long string of green jade beads wound several times around her neck and one wrist; a braided silk belt. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a horn lantern with a small yellow flame; the left arm presses a thick cord-bound road book against her side. Power: a soft green aura gathers about her and tiny green motes of wood qi circle the lamp like fireflies, the silver cape faintly shimmering. Background: a dim hall of wooden pillars, shelves of bound books, mist at the floor. Light: yellow lantern glow on the lower right of her face, cool moonlit blue at the left, a gentle halo on the silver straw. Expression: patient, wise, tender.

people.imagined: A night at the hall of lamps. He keeps his hand near the bronze cup at his throat, which he has never taken off; he knows his life lamp is still burning somewhere behind the ridge and he sleeps lightly.
people.subject: The moment: standing quiet in a doorway at night, hand half raised toward his throat, eyes on the viewer. Face: most important, the bronze cup: a small round bronze cup, dull and dented, hangs on a dark worn cord at his throat in the hollow of his collarbone, big and clear. A quiet, lean, long face of about thirty-nine with a straight nose; kind grey eyes with dark circles; neat straight black brows; thin lips in a half smile; a clean-shaven jaw with a faint shadow; a faint scar under the chin and a small mole beside the ear. Hair: black, brushed back and tied low with a grey silk band. Body: lean, upright, narrow shoulders. Clothing: layered grey-brown silk with two crossed collars and a green silk sash of an inner disciple, a grey-green gauze over-robe with narrow vine embroidery at the cuffs, a plain gold-straw cape folded over one shoulder. Hands and objects: a bamboo staff in the left hand; the right hand lifted toward the cup, fingers long and clean. Power: a faint grey thread of metal qi hangs in the air around the cup, and a distant small flame seems to answer it, far behind his shoulder. Background: a dark doorway, a hanging lantern with a small yellow flame, rain behind catching the light in long silver threads. Light: warm lantern glow on the left, cool blue-grey moonlight from behind, a soft rim along his shoulder. Expression: careful, humble, a kind tired half-smile of a man who sleeps lightly.

people.imagined: The ferry landing at the isle's edge, the evening after the isle rose. He sits on the gunwale with the gourd of rice wine, which never seems to empty, and plants his staff against the water. The staff is also his pole.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a ferry rail at evening he lifts a gourd as if toasting the viewer. Face: most important, the gourd: a big round pale-brown gourd with a red cord, held up at the shoulder, filling a third of the frame. A thick-necked, round, ruddy face of about fifty-three, crinkled eyes the colour of dark tea; thick eyebrows; a broad nose with broken veins; a wide grin with a missing side tooth; a neatly trimmed grey moustache; thin red veins across his cheeks and a shine of wine on his lip. Hair: grey and thick, in a topknot with a river-blue silk strip. Body: burly, broad, arms thick as logs. Clothing: robes of brown silk with a sleeveless vest of olive silk over bare arms, wide sleeves pushed up, a cape of gold-grey straw fine as silk slipped down to the elbows, a river-blue sash round his belly. Hands and objects: the gourd in his right hand; in his left a long bamboo staff with a metal-tipped end planted into the water as a pole. Power: a soft blue-green haze of water and wood qi ripples out around the staff in widening rings. Background: a wide river in evening mist, a low grassy isle with a small planted flag-pole, no flag. Light: low orange sunset from the upper left gilding the gourd and the sash, a soft shimmer on the water. Expression: stubborn, jovial, shrewd, crinkled eyes bright over the gourd.

people.imagined: The mine office, late. She turns a wrist to show the tally-cord knotted round it, running a thumb along the knots, and keeps the account of every cartload. She does not forget a broken arm.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim mine office she lifts her left wrist toward the viewer to check a knotted cord, eyes sliding aside with suspicion. Face: most important, the tally cord: a thick grey cord wound three times around the left wrist with dozens of fat knots in a row, large and clear. A sharp, pale, narrow face of about forty-one with a long pointed chin; dark narrow suspicious eyes; thin straight brows; a hooked nose; pursed thin lips; two faint lines from nostrils to mouth corners. Hair: black, pulled back hard into a bun held by a thin silver pin, a few strands loose. Body: tall, thin, angular, one shoulder higher than the other. Clothing: robes of brown silk with two crossed collars and a green silk sash, a grey-green gauze over-robe with fine silver-thread vines at the cuffs, a gold-straw cape thrown over one shoulder, a belt with a ring of small iron keys. Hands and objects: the left wrist with the cord; in the right a small balance scale with two tiny brass pans; long ink-dark fingers, nails clipped short. Power: a cold grey-gold shimmer of metal qi gathers along the cord and the scale, tiny motes like filings floating in the lamp light. Background: a dim stone-lined room, a lamp, shelves of glinting ore samples. Light: yellow lamp glow from the lower right, cool silver-blue shadow from the upper left. Expression: suspicious, vengeful, tightly controlled.

people.imagined: The forest road at a run-walk, the staff across her shoulders like a yoke. She has just come down at speed, and with a letter for the hostage in her cuff she stops to grin.
people.subject: The moment: mid-stride on a forest road she stops suddenly, grinning, a staff slung across her shoulders with both wrists draped over it like a yoke. Face: most important, the staff yoke and the red thread: a long bamboo staff lies across the back of her neck, forearms draped over each end, and the sandals at her feet, visible at the bottom, are tied with bright red silk thread. A long, sun-burned, freckled face of about twenty-eight; wide bright amber eyes; arched brows; a straight nose peeling at the tip; a wide open grin, cheeks glowing, lashes damp with sweat. Hair: dark brown in a high thick ponytail tied with red thread, swinging sideways. Body: long-legged, slim, strong, leaning forward. Clothing: a short tunic of green silk, hem above the knee, wide sleeves tied back, the green sash of an inner disciple with a small jade clasp, tan silk leggings, a small gold straw cape at the shoulders, a flat satchel at the hip; a letter tucked in the cuff. Power: a breeze of green wood qi streams behind her, leaves and bright motes swirling in her wake. Background: a green rainy forest path in haze, tall bamboo leaning over, a shaft of light on wet leaves. Light: bright green-gold spirit-light from the upper left, a luminous rim on her hair. Expression: breezy, quick, bright, freckled nose wrinkled.

people.imagined: A mine road at the end of a shift, the load just lifted off his head. The groove across his forehead is still pale and deep; he straightens slowly, wary of who watches, and his eyes give nothing.
people.subject: The moment: at the end of a shift a bowed old porter lifts his face slowly toward the viewer, the load just off his forehead. Face: most important, the groove: a deep, pale, wide band of indented skin runs straight across the whole forehead from temple to temple where a carrying strap has sat for sixty years, the skin above it red. A long, lean, brown, lined face of about sixty-six with a heavy chin; small tired eyes under sagging lids; thin grey brows; a flat nose; a patient closed mouth; a few grey whiskers. Hair: thin grey, tied in a short knot, flat from the strap. Body: stooped, shoulders forward, thick wrists. Clothing: plain but clean and graceful for a humble outer disciple: a brown silk tunic with crossed collars, a coarse undyed silk-linen waistcoat, a dusty straw cape tied at the waist, trousers tucked into straw-wrapped boots; no ornament. Hands and objects: two large knotted hands holding the ends of a woven strap that hangs at his chest; at his feet a block of grey-brown ore with a faint gold vein. Power: a faint grey-gold glimmer of metal qi rises from the ore, no more. Background: a mine yard with wooden rails and a cart, dust hanging golden in the air. Light: soft dusty gold light from the upper left, mist at the edges. Expression: eyes lowered a little and shadowed by the lids, mouth closed, face giving nothing away.

people.imagined: A wet road at night, lamp held out at arm's length. Two Tower people have just asked her to put the lamp out; she tilts her head back and laughs, and the flame does not move.
people.subject: The moment: on a wet road at night she holds a lantern out at arm's length and laughs, head tipped back. Face: most important, the grey streak: a thick streak of grey-white lamp wax spattered across the front of her black hair from forehead to ear, bright and big. A round, cheeky, tanned face of about twenty with dimples; large bright eyes; thin arched eyebrows; a small upturned nose; a wide laughing mouth; a wax freckle on the cheek; raindrops shining on her cheeks, eyes narrowed with laughter. Hair: black and glossy, in two short tails tied with green silk cord, a few strands loose at the temple. Body: small, quick, bouncy. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple: a short tunic of bright green silk with crossed collars and wide sleeves, a bright new gold straw cape slung back on one shoulder, a woven silk belt with a coil of cord, a leather glove on the lantern hand. Hands and objects: a horn-paned lantern with a steady yellow flame at the end of her straight right arm; her left hand on her hip. Power: a small bright green aura of wood qi dances around the flame, which does not flicker. Background: a wet black forest in drifting mist, silver rain, a thin stream of rainwater down the road. Light: golden lantern glow on her face from the lower right, blue moonlight on the left, glittering rim light on the rain. Expression: laughing, defiant, fearless delight.

people.imagined: The bamboo grove at midday. He has been cutting so long that splinters have grown into a pelt on his forearms, and he tests a standing culm by rapping it with a knuckle and smiling when it rings right.
people.subject: The moment: in a bamboo grove at midday he raps a standing culm with one knuckle, head tilted, listening, and smiles when it rings. Face: most important, the forearms: both bare forearms bristle with hundreds of fine pale splinters like a pelt of golden-brown hair, held up before him. A broad, calm, round face of about eighteen with full cheeks; narrow contented eyes; short thick brows; a snub nose; a small peaceful smile. Hair: short black bristle. Body: big, sturdy, wide shoulders, soft belly resting slightly over his belt, weight on both feet. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple: a short-sleeved olive silk tunic with crossed collars, a plain sash with a bamboo knife in its sheath, trousers tied at the knee, a straw hat on his back; no apron. Hands and objects: one hand rapping the culm; the other holding a short billhook with a curved blade and dark worn handle at his side; fresh green shavings curl at his feet. Power: a soft green breath of wood qi shimmers along the culm when it rings, motes floating up like pollen, giving the splinters a sheen like fur. Background: a dense wall of tall pale-green bamboo in luminous haze. Light: soft green spirit-light from the upper left, dappled, with a gentle glow through the leaves. Expression: head tilted, eyes soft and absorbed, a small peaceful smile.

people.imagined: A harbour wall at morning. He holds a rolled paper telescope to one eye, aimed at nothing, to look like a man with sight beyond others, and calculates what a traveller will pay.
people.subject: The moment: on a harbour wall at morning he holds a rolled paper tube to his right eye and aims it at the sea, the other eye wide open and sly. Face: most important, the paper telescope: a tube of rolled pale paper tied with twine in three places, a hand-span long, with a faint brown thumbprint at one end, pressed to his right eye, large in the frame. A narrow, smooth, handsome face of about twenty-three; a pointed chin; a thin moustache; a wide open left eye gleaming with calculation; arched brows; a smooth wide smile. Hair: black and oiled, combed back, a small tail at the nape tied with a blue silk ribbon. Body: slim, showy, one hip cocked, chest out, free elbow cocked. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple, worn with flair: a sea-grey silk robe with two crossed collars and wide sleeves, a blue sash worn rakishly, a short gold straw cape over one shoulder, a leather coin pouch slightly open with two copper coins showing. Hands and objects: the tube; his other hand open at his side, palm up. Power: a faint blue shimmer of water qi on the sea glare behind him. Background: a stone harbour wall, a pearl-grey sea, a few masts in mist. Light: bright pale morning light from the upper left, soft sea glare making a bright outline around his hair and sleeve. Expression: smooth, sly, ambitious.

people.imagined: The practice yard. She has just floored her opponent and keeps striking. Her father's staff cut down to her height is in her hand; in her eyes the Tower is at the other end of it.
people.subject: The moment: in a bare practice yard she stands over a fallen opponent, staff raised for another blow, glaring. Face: most important, the staff and the stare: a short bamboo staff, old and worn pale, gripped in two fists at head height and cut down to her size, and eyes with no mercy in them. A narrow, hard, pale face of about thirty-two with sharp cheekbones; very dark unblinking eyes; straight dark brows drawn together; a thin nose; a thin mouth in a flat line; a fine bead of sweat at the temple. Hair: black, in a tight braid wound around the head and fixed with a plain silver pin. Body: slim, taut, in a low stance. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer-gate disciple: a close dark-green silk tunic with two crossed collars and narrow sleeves, a green sash, wrist guards, a gold straw cape thrown back, leggings tied at the knee. Hands and objects: both hands gripping the short staff, its grain dark where her hands hold it, the cut end pale and new; at the bottom of the frame the sleeve of someone fallen. Power: a hard grey-gold glint of metal qi and a green wood shimmer coil around the staff, with fine motes thrown off by the blow. Background: a bare earth yard, a bamboo fence, a pale sky. Light: cold silver spirit-light from the upper left, a sharp rim on her braid and shoulder. Expression: cold, relentless, hungry.

people.imagined: 690, the pass where the forest road leaves the hills. A memorial portrait of the founder, who paid the rain no attention: the straw cape, the bamboo staff, the straw sandals, a man who looks at the sky and lets it fall.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with darkened edges: a lean man standing in falling rain, ignoring it. Face: most important, the straw cape and the rain: a big shaggy cape of straw fine as silk fills the lower frame, fine slanted lines of rain falling all around him. A long, calm, brown, weathered face of about fifty; wide gentle eyes half-closed against the water; straight grey-black brows; a broad nose; a thin grey beard under the chin; a faint contented smile, fine lines of old laughter around the eyes, a drip of water trailing down the beard. Hair: black streaked with grey, in a topknot with a silver-green jade pin. Body: lean, relaxed, upright. Clothing: the founder's robes in the sect's richest version, softened by the fade: layers of brown and olive silk with three crossed collars, a deep olive gauze over-robe embroidered with jungle vines in faded silver thread, a silk rope belt, straw sandals over bare feet just visible, a bundle on the back. Hands and objects: a bamboo staff in his right hand planted lightly; the left hand open at his side. Power: a faint green aura of wood qi around him, softened by the fade, the rain parting a hair's breadth around his shoulders. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, faint pale hills and slanted rain lines. Light: soft grey-silver light from the upper left, dark vignette, the silk fade turning the straw pale ochre and the rain grey-blue. Expression: untroubled, at ease, a man who lets the sky do as it likes.

people.imagined: 1169, the ninth day of sitting in the rain. A memorial portrait of the second head, old and stubborn, sitting on the forest road in the rain with water running off his straw hat, refusing the Tower's arts.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the second head, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with darkened edges: an old man sits cross-legged and upright in the rain. Face: most important, the rain: a wide straw hat with water running in silver lines off its brim in front of his face, thin slanted rain lines across the whole picture. A long, gaunt, weathered face of about sixty-eight; white eyebrows; closed or half-closed eyes; a long nose; a long white beard to the chest, wet and clinging; a firm set mouth. Hair: white, under the hat, tied in a low bun with a plain jade pin. Body: thin, upright, still, spine straight, knees folded neatly beneath the soaked robe, shoulders hunched with age. Clothing: the sect's richest elder version, soaked and faded: grey-brown and olive silk with three crossed collars, a deep olive gauze over-robe embroidered with jungle vines in silver thread, soaked dark at the shoulders, a gold-silver straw cape pooled around him, a silk rope belt, bare feet. Hands and objects: a pale thin bamboo staff with a worn grip laid across his knees, both long veined hands resting on it, water dripping from its end in a line of drops. Power: a faint blue-green aura of water and wood qi, softened by the fade, the rain drifting around him as if refusing to touch his stillness. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with a hint of dark forest trunks. Light: soft grey-silver light from the upper left, dark vignette. Expression: eyes closed, jaw firm, a face at rest and unmoving as stone.

people.imagined: 1156, the mountain pass in the Cinnabar Vein War. A memorial portrait of the brother of the head, a guide, who stayed at the rear and did not come out, holding a guide's jade token and a lantern.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a guide, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with darkened edges, standing in a pass holding a lantern and looking over his shoulder at those leaving. Face: most important, the jade token: a green jade guide's token on a cord hangs on his chest, clearly visible and pale green against the brown. A broad, weathered, brown face of about forty-six, a family likeness to a strong brother; steady dark eyes; straight brows; a wide nose; calm lips; grey stubble; deep lines from nose to mouth corners. Hair: black, short, tied under a plain silk band with a small jade bead. Body: broad, solid, relaxed. Clothing: faded robes of brown silk with two crossed collars and a green sash, a grey-green gauze over-robe with narrow vine embroidery at the cuffs, a gold-straw cape over one shoulder, cord-wrapped leggings. Hands and objects: a horn lantern held low in the right hand with a small steady flame; a bamboo staff in the left. Power: a faint green hint of wood qi drifts about him, softened by the fade, a few motes around the lantern. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, the faint outline of a narrow rocky pass in mist. Light: soft silver light from the upper left, dark vignette, a small yellow glow at the lantern; the faded silk tone leaves the green of the jade as the one cool colour among ochre and grey. Expression: calm, loyal, unafraid, a guide looking back at the people he has let go ahead.
